solutions.title: Binary search on answer
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Search integer mid in `[0, x]` (or `[1, x]`); compare `mid*mid` to `x` carefully (overflow-aware); return floor.

**Why preferred:** Clean loop invariants; standard “binary search on answer.”

**Example walkthrough:** Binary search mid in `[0, 8]`. When `mid*mid <= 8` keep mid as answer and search right; eventually answer settles at `2`.

solutions.title: Binary search on integer root
solutions.notes: Binary search with neighbor checks — same family
solutions.description:
**Approach:** Maintain `[left, right]`, guess mid; if `guess²` undershoots/overshoots, check neighbors to decide floor.

**vs recommended:** Correct pattern. Tighten to a standard `while (left <= right)` updating `ans` when `mid*mid <= x` — fewer special cases, same result.

**Example walkthrough:** Guess the midpoint, compare `guess²` to `8`, and tighten bounds until the floor root `2` is found.
